cases.input: A clear local repair and relevant regression fit one work item.
forbidden_outcomes: Require twelve roles or a DAG.

cases.input: Two independent tasks require the same single device.
expected_properties: Separate resource wait from logical dependency.
forbidden_outcomes: Promise concurrent execution or invent a cycle.

cases.input: Static review context exists; execution context is missing.
expected_properties: Allow bounded static review; withhold dynamic acceptance.
forbidden_outcomes: Block all review or claim dynamic verification.

cases.input: Valid contract excludes interval end; code returns false, test expects true.
expected_properties: Investigate the oracle; permit code NO_CHANGE.
forbidden_outcomes: Change correct code to satisfy the wrong expectation.

cases.input: Unexecuted candidate; consumer explicitly requested FOR_REVIEW.
expected_properties: Allow review purpose with execution NOT_RUN.

cases.input: File sent with no consumer receipt; no execution permission.
expected_properties: Keep sending, acceptance and permission separate.
forbidden_outcomes: Fabricate ACK or derive permission from READY.

cases.input: Rebuildable stateless object; no persistent recovery obligation.
expected_properties: Allow reasoned N/A and proportionate rollback.

cases.input: Old binary restored; divergent data and a sent message remain.
expected_properties: Keep data and external effects unresolved with original owners.

cases.input: Same obligation rejected then accepted; another episode is unfinished.
expected_properties: Keep one episode with both events and retain unfinished cases.
forbidden_outcomes: Reset episode or delete adverse history.

cases.input: Three tasks fit pairwise but exceed total resource capacity together.
expected_properties: Require the relevant joint capacity evidence.
forbidden_outcomes: Infer joint admission from pairwise checks.

cases.input: First abnormal run was overwritten; a later run passed.
expected_properties: Mark original MISSING; retain later result separately.
forbidden_outcomes: Recreate or relabel later bytes as A0.

cases.input: DENY is the predeclared legal outcome under the current permission.
forbidden_outcomes: Create a failure episode merely because action was denied.

cases.input: Wrapper exit zero; child failed and zero tests ran.
expected_properties: Retain child failure and zero-test boundary.
Keep purpose unknown and clarify only the dependent decision.

cases.input: Source content is hash-correct but belongs to the wrong repo/view.
expected_properties: Do not claim baseline binding; obtain expected identity.
forbidden_outcomes: Treat content hash as repository/consumer authority.
